answer_relevance.description: Weighted keyword coverage and TF-IDF lexical similarity to expected concepts; not embedding-based factual verification.

star_structure.description: Used only for behavioral questions; measures detectable Situation, Task, Action, and Result structure.

fluency_markers.description: Transcript filler markers and pace only when response duration is supplied.

communication_clarity.description: Sentence-length range and explicit discourse-transition markers; not a psychological assessment.

star_definitions.Situation: Sets the scene, explains the background context, company, project, or problem environment.
star_definitions.Task: Defines the specific responsibility, objective, challenge, or expectation assigned to the candidate.
star_definitions.Action: Explains the concrete actions, strategies, technical tools, leadership, and steps taken by the candidate.
star_definitions.Result: Quantifies the outcome, metrics improved, business value delivered, lessons learned, and team impact.
